//@version=6
indicator('Minervini Ultimate +VCP', overlay = true)

// ==========================================
// 1. INPUTS (Settings)
// ==========================================

// --- Group 1: General display settings ---
grp_display = '1. Table Display & Position'
table_pos_input = input.string('Top Right', 'Table Position', options = ['Top Left', 'Top Center', 'Top Right', 'Middle Left', 'Middle Center', 'Middle Right', 'Bottom Left', 'Bottom Center', 'Bottom Right'], group = grp_display)
table_size_input = input.string('Small', 'Table Size', options = ['Tiny', 'Small', 'Normal', 'Large', 'Huge'], group = grp_display)
show_pressure = input.bool(true, 'Show Pressure Row', group = grp_display)
show_risk = input.bool(true, 'Show Buy Risk Row', group = grp_display)
show_tpr = input.bool(true, 'Show TPR Row', group = grp_display)
show_rpr = input.bool(true, 'Show RPR Row', group = grp_display)
show_vcp = input.bool(true, 'Show VCP Row', group = grp_display)

// --- Group 2: Moving Averages ---
grp_ma = '2. Moving Averages'
ma50_len = input.int(50, '50-Day MA Length', group = grp_ma)
c_ma50 = input.color(color.blue, '50-Day Line Color', group = grp_ma)

ma150_len = input.int(150, '150-Day MA Length', group = grp_ma)
c_ma150 = input.color(color.orange, '150-Day Line Color', group = grp_ma)

ma200_len = input.int(200, '200-Day MA Length', group = grp_ma)
c_ma200 = input.color(color.red, '200-Day Line Color', group = grp_ma)

// --- Group 3: Colors ---
grp_colors = '3. Table Colors'
c_text_lbl = input.color(color.white, 'Label Text Color', group = grp_colors)
c_text_val = input.color(color.white, 'Value Text Color', group = grp_colors)
c_bg_lbl = input.color(color.new(color.gray, 20), 'Label Background', group = grp_colors)

c_good = input.color(color.green, 'Status: GOOD', group = grp_colors)
c_warn = input.color(color.yellow, 'Status: WARNING', group = grp_colors)
c_bad = input.color(color.new(color.red, 10), 'Status: BAD', group = grp_colors)
c_neutral = input.color(color.gray, 'Status: NEUTRAL', group = grp_colors)
c_squeeze = input.color(color.aqua, 'Status: SQUEEZE', group = grp_colors)

// --- Group 4: Params ---
grp_params = '4. Calculation Parameters'
vcp_lookback = input.int(5, 'VCP Lookback (Days)', group = grp_params)
vcp_thresh = input.float(2.5, 'VCP Tightness %', step = 0.1, group = grp_params)
bm_sym = input.symbol('SPY', 'Benchmark Symbol (for RPR)', group = grp_params)

// ==========================================
// 2. CALCULATIONS
// ==========================================

// --- Moving Averages ---
ma50 = ta.sma(close, ma50_len)
ma150 = ta.sma(close, ma150_len)
ma200 = ta.sma(close, ma200_len)

// Plot MAs
plot(ma50, title="50 SMA", color=c_ma50, linewidth=2)
plot(ma150, title="150 SMA", color=c_ma150, linewidth=2)
plot(ma200, title="200 SMA", color=c_ma200, linewidth=2)

// --- TPR (Trend Template) ---
high_52wk = ta.highest(high, 252)
low_52wk = ta.lowest(low, 252)

// Criteria checks
c1 = close > ma150 and close > ma200
c2 = ma150 > ma200
c3 = ma200 > ma200[20] // 200MA trending up
c4 = ma50 > ma150 and ma50 > ma200
c5 = close > ma50
c6 = close > low_52wk * 1.25 // At least 25% above 52-wk low
c7 = close > high_52wk * 0.75 // Within 25% of 52-wk high

tpr_pass = c1 and c2 and c3 and c4 and c5 and c6 and c7
tpr_txt = tpr_pass ? 'PASSED' : 'WAIT'
tpr_bg = tpr_pass ? c_good : c_bad

// --- BUY RISK (Distance from 50MA) ---
dist_50 = (close - ma50) / ma50 * 100
risk_status = dist_50 < 0 ? 'Broken' : dist_50 <= 15 ? 'Low Risk' : dist_50 <= 25 ? 'Caution' : 'Extended'
risk_col = dist_50 < 0 ? c_neutral : dist_50 <= 15 ? c_good : dist_50 <= 25 ? c_warn : c_bad

// --- PRESSURE (Volume Analysis) ---
buy_vol = math.sum(close > open ? volume : 0, 20)
sell_vol = math.sum(close <= open ? volume : 0, 20)
pressure_val = buy_vol > sell_vol
pressure_txt = pressure_val ? 'Buying' : 'Selling'
pressure_col = pressure_val ? c_good : c_bad

// --- RPR (Relative Price Strength vs Benchmark) ---
roc(src, len) => 
    (src - src[len]) / src[len] * 100

sym_roc3 = roc(close, 63)
sym_roc6 = roc(close, 126)
sym_roc9 = roc(close, 189)
sym_roc12 = roc(close, 252)

// Get Benchmark data safely
bm_close = request.security(bm_sym, timeframe.period, close)
bm_roc3 = roc(bm_close, 63)
bm_roc6 = roc(bm_close, 126)
bm_roc9 = roc(bm_close, 189)
bm_roc12 = roc(bm_close, 252)

rs_raw = sym_roc3 * 0.4 + sym_roc6 * 0.2 + sym_roc9 * 0.2 + sym_roc12 * 0.2
bm_raw = bm_roc3 * 0.4 + bm_roc6 * 0.2 + bm_roc9 * 0.2 + bm_roc12 * 0.2

rpr_calc = 50 + rs_raw - bm_raw
rpr_proxy = math.max(1, math.min(99, rpr_calc)) // Clamp between 1-99
rpr_col = rpr_proxy > 80 ? c_good : rpr_proxy > 70 ? c_warn : c_neutral

// --- VCP (Volatility Contraction) ---
vcp_highest = ta.highest(close, vcp_lookback)
vcp_lowest = ta.lowest(close, vcp_lookback)
vcp_range_pct = (vcp_highest - vcp_lowest) / close * 100
vcp_trigger = vcp_range_pct < vcp_thresh

vcp_txt = vcp_trigger ? 'SQUEEZE' : 'Normal'
vcp_bg = vcp_trigger ? c_squeeze : c_neutral

plotshape(vcp_trigger and show_vcp, style = shape.circle, location = location.belowbar, color = c_squeeze, size = size.tiny, title = 'VCP Dot')

// ==========================================
// 3. TABLE DRAWING
// ==========================================

// Determine Position
pos = table_pos_input == 'Top Left' ? position.top_left : 
      table_pos_input == 'Top Center' ? position.top_center : 
      table_pos_input == 'Top Right' ? position.top_right : 
      table_pos_input == 'Middle Left' ? position.middle_left : 
      table_pos_input == 'Middle Center' ? position.middle_center : 
      table_pos_input == 'Middle Right' ? position.middle_right : 
      table_pos_input == 'Bottom Left' ? position.bottom_left : 
      table_pos_input == 'Bottom Center' ? position.bottom_center : position.bottom_right

// Determine Size
sz = table_size_input == 'Tiny' ? size.tiny : 
     table_size_input == 'Small' ? size.small : 
     table_size_input == 'Normal' ? size.normal : 
     table_size_input == 'Large' ? size.large : size.huge

// Create Table
var tbl = table.new(pos, 2, 6, border_width = 1)

if barstate.islast
    row = 0
    
    // Header (Optional, or just start filling rows)
    // Row: Pressure
    if show_pressure
        table.cell(tbl, 0, row, 'Pressure', bgcolor=c_bg_lbl, text_color=c_text_lbl, text_size=sz)
        table.cell(tbl, 1, row, pressure_txt, bgcolor=pressure_col, text_color=c_text_val, text_size=sz)
        row += 1
        
    // Row: Buy Risk
    if show_risk
        table.cell(tbl, 0, row, 'Risk (50d)', bgcolor=c_bg_lbl, text_color=c_text_lbl, text_size=sz)
        table.cell(tbl, 1, row, risk_status, bgcolor=risk_col, text_color=c_text_val, text_size=sz)
        row += 1
        
    // Row: TPR
    if show_tpr
        table.cell(tbl, 0, row, 'Trend (TPR)', bgcolor=c_bg_lbl, text_color=c_text_lbl, text_size=sz)
        table.cell(tbl, 1, row, tpr_txt, bgcolor=tpr_bg, text_color=c_text_val, text_size=sz)
        row += 1
        
    // Row: RPR
    if show_rpr
        table.cell(tbl, 0, row, 'RS Rating', bgcolor=c_bg_lbl, text_color=c_text_lbl, text_size=sz)
        table.cell(tbl, 1, row, str.tostring(rpr_proxy, '#.0'), bgcolor=rpr_col, text_color=c_text_val, text_size=sz)
        row += 1

    // Row: VCP
    if show_vcp
        table.cell(tbl, 0, row, 'VCP (5d)', bgcolor=c_bg_lbl, text_color=c_text_lbl, text_size=sz)
        table.cell(tbl, 1, row, vcp_txt, bgcolor=vcp_bg, text_color=c_text_val, text_size=sz)
